incomplete.title: Registration is incomplete
incomplete.notInvited: Your invite hasn't been confirmed yet.
incomplete.needProfile: You still need to save your name and introduction and accept the terms.

signIn.noWallet: You don't need a wallet or a balance: Solvers takes care of that.
signIn.p1: Sign in with your email. We send you an access code and create your account on the spot.
signIn.p2: Publishing is free, with no monthly fee.
signIn.p3: Every version goes through an automated check and a review by our team before it goes live.

build.toolSub: A free solver, included in the platform
build.toolText: It walks you through seven steps: the promise and the audience, what sets it apart, the process, the knowledge, the tools, the first conversation and the test cases. At the end it hands you the finished package, already checked by the same validator the site uses.
build.installNote: Installing takes about two minutes and works with Claude and ChatGPT. After that, just ask: “Use Solver Builder to build a solver about [your topic]”.
build.zipTitle: What the ZIP should look like
build.zipTree:
my-solver.zip
├─ manifest.json
├─ steps/       (3 to 6 steps, .md)
├─ knowledge/   (knowledge, .md)
├─ templates/   (ready-made templates)
└─ evals/cases/ (test cases, .json)
build.zipNote: manifest.json goes at the root, not inside an extra folder. Up to {size}.
build.noZipTitle: If your AI can't generate the ZIP
build.noZipText: Some AIs only show the files in the chat. In that case, Solver Builder hands you each file in its own block, with step-by-step instructions to save each one in a folder and compress it. The site checks everything again when you upload.
build.guide: Complete format guide, inside Solver Builder
build.haveZip: I have the ZIP, upload it
build.locked: Uploading opens once your registration and contact are complete

track.text: After you upload, each package goes through these stages. You can follow everything in My submissions and you'll be notified when our team replies.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again and save once more.
errors.inviteRequired: Paste the invite code our team sent you.
errors.inviteUsed: That invite was already used by another account. Ask our team for a new one.
errors.inviteInvalid: That invite code doesn't exist. Check that you copied all of it, or ask our team for a new one.
errors.forbidden: That invite code isn't valid. Check that you copied all of it, or ask our team for a new one.
errors.conflict: That invite was already used by another account.

validation.name: Enter the name that will appear on the storefront (at least {min} letters).
validation.bio: Tell us in a few sentences who you are and what you can do (at least {min} characters).
validation.invite: Paste the invite code our team sent you.
validation.terms: To continue, you need to accept the terms.

invite.label: Invite code
invite.hint: For now, only invited creators can submit solvers. The code comes by email from the Solvers team.

name.label: Storefront name
name.hint: The name buyers see in “by …”. It can be yours or your brand's.

bio.label: About you
bio.hint: {count}/{max} · Experience, field, and the kind of problem you solve.

summary.title: Summary of what you accept
summary.b1: You are responsible for the package's content and have the right to use everything in it. Third-party content needs a source and permission.
summary.b2: Our team reviews every version before it goes live and may ask for changes, reject, suspend or remove a solver.
summary.b3: The platform fee comes out of each sale. The rest goes to your wallet.
summary.b4: A solver may not promise financial, legal or medical results without caveats, act against the user, or send their data elsewhere.

profile.terms: I've read the summary and accept the Solvers terms for creators.

contact.title: Contact for notices and help requests
contact.okText: All set: we'll notify you there when our team replies to a submission or when a buyer asks for help.
contact.text: Before you submit a solver, link your Telegram. That's how we notify you about submissions and how buyers ask for help, without seeing your contact. Click Link Telegram: the site generates a code and you send it to the Solvers bot.
contact.saveFirst: Save your registration first (name, introduction and terms): the button to link appears right after.
contact.later: You can save your registration now and link later, but uploading a package only opens once your contact is linked.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again and try once more.
errors.unavailable: Telegram linking is down right now. Try again in a few minutes or contact our team.
errors.profileRequired: Save your registration (name, introduction and terms) before linking Telegram.
errors.tooMany: You've generated too many codes in a row. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.server: The server didn't respond properly. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: Couldn't generate the code right now.

telegram.statusExpired: The code expired. Generate a new one to continue.
telegram.statusCopied: Command copied. Paste it in the chat with the bot.
telegram.statusWaiting: Waiting for you to send the code to the bot. We'll let you know here as soon as it arrives.
telegram.step1: Tap Open in Telegram and then Start. The code is already filled in.
telegram.step2: Or search for <handle>@{username}</handle> on Telegram and send:
telegram.validUntil: The code is valid until {time} (<tick>{clock}</tick><sr> left</sr>) and works only once.

zip.notZip: “{name}” isn't a ZIP file. Compress the package folder into a .zip and choose again.
zip.tooBig: The file is {size} and the limit is {max}. Remove anything that isn't part of the package and compress again.
zip.pickedHint: Check the file below and upload it.
zip.hint: A .zip file up to {max}, with manifest.json at the root.
zip.uploaded: Uploaded. Waiting for the server to confirm receipt…
zip.note: The server checks the package again, even if you've already validated it on your computer. If there are errors, you'll see everything on the tracking screen and nothing goes to the team's review.

toast.title: Signed and confirmed
toast.text: The network recorded your confirmation. Follow the next steps here.

cosign.blockedTitle: This solver is blocked on the network
cosign.blockedText: It is suspended or registered by another account. Contact our team.
cosign.awaitTitle: Waiting for the platform's final approval
cosign.awaitText: You've signed and the network confirmed it. The Solvers team now gives the final approval with a separate offline key (it is never done from the site). Then the solver goes on the storefront. You don't need to do anything.
cosign.doneText: Publishing is being completed. This page updates by itself.

text.register: Our team approved the package. Sign once with your account to register the solver as yours, with the approved price, royalty and license limit.
text.pricing: The version is already on the network. Sign once to apply the approved price and terms.
text.version: Our team approved the new version. Sign once to publish the update.

li.oneSignature: Everything goes in a single confirmation: you sign once.
li.approved: Price, name and version come from what our team approved ({name} v{version}, {price}). You don't need to type anything.
li.approvedShort: Price, name and version come from what our team approved. You don't need to type anything.
li.deposit: Registering takes a refundable deposit of {stake}. Your balance: {balance}.
li.afterRegister: After the network confirms, our team gives the final approval and the solver goes on the storefront.
li.afterUpdate: After the network confirms, the new version goes live.

cosign.lowTitle: Not enough balance for the deposit
cosign.lowText: The deposit is {stake} and your balance is {balance}.
cosign.confirming: Waiting for the network to confirm…
cosign.footnote: A window from your sign-in may open for you to confirm. The confirmation is valid for a couple of minutes: if it takes too long, just try again.

sign.title: You sign
sign.text: One confirmation with your account. Solvers pays the fee.

confirmed.title: Confirmed on the network
confirmed.text: The network records the registration or the update.

approval.title: Final approval by the platform
approval.text: Only for a new solver: the Solvers team approves it with an offline key, outside the site.

live.title: Live
live.text: The solver appears on the storefront with the approved version.

manage.intro: Each change is one confirmation with your account. Solvers pays the network fee. The license price and the version only change through a new submission.

pricing.title: Price per use
pricing.text: Besides the license, buyers can pay per use. It can't be higher than the license price. Enter 0 to turn it off.
pricing.label: Price per use ({symbol})
pricing.off: Now: pay per use is off · license {price}.

royalty.title: Your share when a license is transferred
royalty.text: When someone passes their license to another person, they pay a royalty on the original price: your share plus the platform's {platform}. Together they can't go over {max}.
royalty.textNoPlatform: When someone passes their license to another person, they pay a royalty on the original price: your share plus the platform's. Together they can't go over {max}.

supply.title: License limit
supply.text: You can set a limit on how many licenses are sold. You can raise it later, but never lower it.

metadata.none: Not set on the network yet.

stake.title: Deposit
stake.text: The deposit backs your solver. You can add to it, or stop selling: people who bought keep their access, and after 30 days you can withdraw the deposit.
stake.retiredText: You asked to stop selling. You can withdraw the deposit 30 days after the request (the team may extend this period if there is an open issue).
stake.cancelNote: Cancelling puts the solver on hold until our team reviews it again.

confirm.title: Stop selling this solver?
confirm.p1: The solver leaves the storefront right away and no new licenses or uses can be bought.
confirm.p2: People who already bought keep their access.
confirm.p3: You can withdraw the deposit after 30 days.
confirm.label: Stop selling

stake.unknown: We couldn't read the deposit's current state right now. You can still try: each action is checked before you confirm.
stake.exitAt: You can withdraw the deposit from {date}.
stake.extended: The team extended the wait {n, plural, one {once} other {# times}} because of an open issue, so the exit can no longer be cancelled.
stake.slashPending: The team proposed taking {amount}. It can be applied from {from} until {until}; meanwhile the deposit can't be withdrawn.
stake.slashContested: You already contested it; the team reads it before deciding.
stake.noExit: There is no exit request on record, so there is nothing to withdraw or cancel.

contest.title: Contest a deposit penalty
contest.text: If our team proposed taking part of your deposit, you can contest it once, with your reasons. The team reads it before deciding.
contest.label: Your reasons
